summary: Route-level hourly sparkline collapses to zero for sampled routes after sampling toggle
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports that hourly sparklines for several routes collapse to a flat zero immediately after their org toggled route-level sampling for a subset of API keys. The total usage counters still show traffic in the same time windows but the per-route mini-graphs are zeroed, which also suppressed alerting tied to small-window spikes.

Impact: Affects Streamlytics' ability to see short-term traffic shifts per route and caused a missed alert for a spike in one route yesterday evening. This impacts debugging and SLA monitoring for their dedicated capacity deployment.

Environment: prod us-west; dedicated cluster for org streamlytics. Sampling disabled -> enabled toggle was executed via Console by their admin at ~2026-03-10T19:05:00Z.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In the Redwood Console for a dedicated org, enable route-level sampling on one or more API keys (sampling rate set to 10%).
2) Wait ~2 minutes for sampling change to propagate, then generate 500 small requests across 3 routes (route-a, route-b, route-c).
3) Open the Usage dashboard and observe hourly sparklines for each route; totals for the time window show traffic but route sparklines for sampled routes show flat zero.
4) Check Alerts -> Recent Evaluations for rules based on per-route hourly rate; no alerts fired for the spike although total counters increased.
logs: Customer-provided console snapshot: sparkline tiles for route-a and route-c are solid gray with '0' label while total row shows 1,024 requests for 20:00-21:00.
Rollup job debug log (2026-03-10T19:07:30Z): INFO rollup.compact key=org=streamlytics|route=route-a|sampled=true buckets=1 -> pruning due to retention_tag=sampled
Alert eval trace (rule id 1283) shows input series missing route-a series at 19:00-19:20 window.
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: rollup/compaction mistakenly treats sampled traffic as ephemeral and evicts buckets keyed to sampled=true, causing zeroed sparklines while raw totals (pre-rollup) still exist.

Checked rollup job codepath: compaction uses retention_tag to decide merge/prune and retention_tag was being set to 'sampled' for any route with sampling enabled; subsequent aggregation query excludes retention_tag != 'full'.
Reproduced in staging by toggling sampling on a test org: observed identical sparklines collapse after compaction run triggered at next hourly rollup.
Confirmed alerts suppressed because alerting pipeline reads from the same rollup/aggregation index that lost sampled-route buckets.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Kapoor (Support): "Contacted customer and requested console screenshots, a list of affected routes, and the approximate time of sampling toggle. Customer provided artifacts and confirmed only route-level sampling was changed."

2026-03-10 - Ben Vargas (SRE): "Reproduced issue in staging. Suspect compaction retains only 'full' retention_tag. Drafting a patch to ensure sampled routes are either preserved with their sampled metadata or merged into full buckets for dashboard windowing."

2026-03-11 - Carlos Mendez (Eng - rollup): "Patch ready: change compaction to preserve bucket counts for retention_tag=sampled and emit merged metric series for UI queries (backcompat). Running CI and will deploy hotfix to canary cluster."

2026-03-12 - Ben Vargas: "Canary deploy applied to us-west dedicated cluster at 09:30 UTC. Reprocessed 2 hours of raw events for streamlytics; confirmed sparklines show non-zero values and alerts re-evaluated. Monitoring for regressions."

2026-03-12 - Aisha Kapoor: "Notified customer of fix and asked them to validate dashboards and alerting; customer confirmed route sparklines restored and an alert from the previous spike would have fired after backfill."
resolution: Hotfix deployed to rollup compaction: compaction now preserves sampled buckets and emits merged series for UI queries. Backfilled two hours of raw events for the affected org; sparklines and alerting restored. Follow-ups: add unit tests for retention_tag handling, add a regression test in staging, and add dashboard SLO check for per-route series entropy post-compaction. Customer notified and ticket set to monitor for 72 hours before closing.
follow_up_actions: Add unit test covering retention_tag=sampled merge behavior (ENG-ROLLUP-1457)
Create a staging regression test that toggles sampling and runs compaction (owner: Carlos Mendez)
Add an observability alert that flags sudden zeroing of >20% of route-level series in an org within 1h (owner: SRE)
